main.title: Summary
text: Unity developer with 5 years of experience on live-ops mobile games. Shipped 3 titles with over 10M combined downloads. Strong in performance optimisation, multiplayer and backend integration.

items.heading: Senior Unity Developer — Example Games
bullets: Built real-time PvP mode with Photon Fusion; matchmaking via PlayFab.
Reduced memory usage by 30% with Addressables and texture atlases.
Set up automated builds for iOS and Android on Jenkins.
Worked with designers on live events and A/B tests.

items.heading: Unity Developer — Sample Studio (sample)
bullets: Developed core gameplay and UI for two puzzle games.
Integrated Firebase Analytics and in-app purchases.
